name: My save site
_about: Drop this object into updates/saves-backend.json (consoles fetch it with the catalog and before listing saves) or paste url + anonKey into Settings → Saves → Backend on a console. The anon key is public by design: row-level security limits it to reading rows, inserting pending submissions and uploading into the bucket, and consoles send it to this URL only. Keep indexUrl so the GitHub index stays merged with the database (deduped by sha256 / garlic id). "moderated": true makes console inserts carry status 'pending' + source 'xeno' (what migration 0004's insert policy requires); "downloadCounter" names the RPC consoles call after a verified download; "garlicList": true would also list rows live through the garlic function (a Garlic scrape per refresh — the 0003 sync cron puts them in the table instead). "name" is the label the share wizard shows. The XenoKing site needs none of these flags: its table takes the plain columns and has no counter. Run migrations 0000 → 0001 → 0002 → 0004 → 0005 (0005 lets consoles upload their shares as xeno/<yyyymmdd>-<16 hex>.zip). Typed into Settings instead, the console recognises this template by one read (select=status) and behaves as moderated with the increment_downloads counter.
